svg.title: Job Search Workflows
svg.desc: Work history and peer feedback support resume tailoring. Find and Request Referrals and Find and Apply to Jobs use your confirmation before sending requests or submitting applications. Both routes can lead to interviews. Interview Coach supports practice, and Offer Negotiator supports a human decision. Both coaches are available anytime. Data is yellow, skills blue and human input gray.
svg.text: Review jobs → confirm → fill forms & submit
High-quality technical and behavioral interview material
Start anywhere. Your agent uses the tools and access you provide.
